metaTitle: Custom Direct to Film Nursing Scrubs | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom direct to film nursing scrubs in bulk. Durable, vibrant prints for healthcare teams. Get your quote today.
introHtml: Direct to film printing creates crisp, full-color designs on nursing scrubs without the heavy feel of traditional screen printing. This method works well for complex logos, gradients, or detailed artwork on polyester and poly-cotton blends common in medical uniforms. For hospital systems or clinics ordering staff scrubs, DTF offers excellent color retention through repeated industrial washing. The result is a soft-hand print that moves with the wearer and holds up to daily shifts.
